purpose: Verify five targeted fixes from cross-task-reality-review iter1. Check no new critical issues introduced.

task_1_redis_testcontainer_note.issue: Note references GenericContainer<>("redis:7-alpine").withExposedPorts(6379) with @DynamicPropertySource — correct. But the note says to override spring.data.redis.host and spring.data.redis.port, while Task 1 step 1 binds REDIS_URL to spring.data.redis.url. These are two different Spring Boot Redis config approaches and they conflict. The app property is .url but the test override hint uses .host/.port.

task_3_awaitility_attribution.note: Line 98 now correctly states: 'Awaitility is available via spring-boot-starter-test transitive dependency.' Testcontainers attribution removed.

task_4_dependency_and_principal_contract.note: Dependencies section line 128 explicitly states EmailService is NOT a dependency for event logging; EventService is created within Task 4 itself. Principal name contract note at line 145 says getUsername() must return user id (MongoDB ObjectId string), not email.

task_9_spring_session_not_in_redis_row.note: Line 34 explicitly says spring-session-data-mongodb stores sessions in MongoDB, not Redis — do not add it to the Redis row. patterns.md CSRF update is now in scope (lines 25-26 and step 3 in What to do).

task_11_ux_guidelines_parallel_note.note: Note at line 94 warns that ux-guidelines.md is updated by Task 9 in parallel and instructs relying on tech-spec Decision 5 as fallback. However, depends_on: [8] is unchanged — Task 9 is NOT declared as a dependency. The structural parallel-execution risk remains; the note is a documentation-level mitigation, not a dependency fix. Acceptable given Decision 5 is authoritative and the note is explicit.

findings.issue: Redis Testcontainer DynamicPropertySource hint (line 134) says to map spring.data.redis.host and spring.data.redis.port. But Task 1 step 1 binds REDIS_URL to spring.data.redis.url (url-based config, not host/port). These are mutually exclusive Spring Boot Redis config approaches. If the app is configured with spring.data.redis.url, then @DynamicPropertySource in AbstractIntegrationTest must override spring.data.redis.url=redis://localhost:{container.getMappedPort(6379)}, NOT spring.data.redis.host + spring.data.redis.port. Using host/port overrides will not work when the app property binding is url-based.
findings.fix: Update the DynamicPropertySource hint to: 'Override spring.data.redis.url=redis://localhost:{container.getMappedPort(6379)} (matching the application.properties binding). Do NOT override spring.data.redis.host/port — those are inactive when url-based config is used.'

findings.issue: Task 11 depends_on: [8] but not [9]. Task 9 (updating ux-guidelines.md) runs in parallel in Wave 6. The note at line 94 documents this and provides the Decision 5 fallback — which is correct and sufficient. However, the dependency omission is still technically present. The mitigation note is adequate for implementation safety, but wave-enforcement tooling will not block Task 11 from starting before Task 9 completes.
findings.fix: Accepted mitigation via note + Decision 5 reference. Optionally add 9 to depends_on: [8, 9] to make the ordering machine-enforceable, but the note is sufficient for human-driven execution.
